name: Dragon Slayer

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +1 weapon; an extra 3d6 damage of its type against Dragons.
text: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The weapon deals an extra 3d6 damage of the weapon's type to any Dragon it hits.
